name: prism-break
description: Prism Break — prison-escape brick breaker (Capacitor wrapper)

scripts.sync: rm -rf www && mkdir -p www && cp index.html manifest.json sw.js icon-192.png icon-512.png www/ && cp -R images www/images
scripts.cap:sync: npm run sync && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:ios: npm run sync && npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
scripts.cap:android: npm run sync && npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
